app.title: PuxiAche
app.tagline: Find as many countries as you can in a minute!

tutorial.title: How to play!
steps: Drag to spin the globe and find the named country.
Smaller countries are worth more points — the smaller, the bigger the score!
Stuck? Just skip and go on.
